about_the_game:
Among Space is a horror game set on the planet EC-10013. You are a researcher of the anomalies of the planet, you were abandoned by your "comrades" during an emergency evacuation. Will you be able to leave the planet or will you find another way to survive?

Your Fate...?

The year is 2039. Humanity is actively colonizing planets beyond our Solar System. Your squad was assigned to investigate anomalies hindering colonization efforts.
Everything went wrong when an unknown lifeform attacked your expedition. In panic, the crew rushed to the escape pods. Everyone knew one pod was damaged. Everyone except you... Now it's just you and your AI assistant Neutrino in this alien world. Will you find the path to survival?

Key to Salvation

Don't forget - Neutrino is the most advanced AI in existence. According to her analysis, an abandoned research facility studying microscopic black holes could hold the key to escaping this nightmare.
Explore every corner of this place, overcoming the various challenges that you will encounter along the way. Be cautious: bloodthirsty monsters lurk at every turn, and don’t let them catch you! Some of them fear the light or your gaze, while others always know where you are...

Where am I?

Your journey won't be limited to just the research center. Explore tiny worlds within black holes, enrich yourself in the diverse mines of this planet, and even confront the monster in your mind, overcoming your own fears and doubts.
